text: What problem does OFDM primarily solve?
choices: Multipath: splitting one fast channel into many slow subcarriers makes each symbol long compared with the delay spread
explanation: A single high-rate carrier has symbols short enough that reflections arriving late overlap the next symbol. Hundreds of low-rate subcarriers give each symbol a long duration, and a cyclic prefix absorbs the remaining delay spread. This is why every modern high-rate radio system converged on it.
